nodes.label: Player Phone View (/player/:characterId)
nodes.rationale: The player view deliberately shows no map: the shared board is the single spatial source of truth, so the phone focuses on the character sheet, resource tracking and dice.

nodes.label: Tech Stack (React + TypeScript + Vite, Node + Express + ws, better-sqlite3)

nodes.label: Locked Mobile Viewport and Dark Theme Color
nodes.norm_label: locked mobile viewport and dark theme color
nodes.rationale: user-scalable=no plus theme-color #14101c tailor the page for player phones used at the table and match the dark grimoire theme.

nodes.label: Open-Only Design Resources Policy
nodes.rationale: Only free open-licensed assets are allowed (Google Fonts Cinzel/Noto Sans, lucide-react ISC, game-icons.net CC-BY 3.0 with in-app attribution, pure CSS animations) to keep the app legally distributable and dependency-light.

nodes.label: Autosave After Every Action
nodes.rationale: A live tabletop session must survive a server crash or restart mid-game, so every mutation is persisted synchronously to SQLite.

nodes.label: Dice Policy (physical default, virtual with auto-modifiers, hidden DM rolls)
nodes.norm_label: dice policy (physical default, virtual with auto-modifiers, hidden dm rolls)
nodes.rationale: Physical dice at the table remain the default; virtual rolls automatically apply modifiers, show the result to the roller and log a line on the shared board, while hidden rolls are DM-only to preserve secrecy.

nodes.label: Local LAN Deployment (no accounts, QR join)
nodes.norm_label: local lan deployment (no accounts, qr join)
nodes.rationale: The game happens in one room: the server runs on the DM's laptop, clients connect over Wi-Fi and join by QR code, which removes the need for accounts, auth and internet hosting.

nodes.label: Agent Rules (file ownership, no npm install, Russian UI)
nodes.norm_label: agent rules (file ownership, no npm install, russian ui)
nodes.rationale: Rules are baked into every subagent prompt so agents write only to their own files, never run npm install (sandbox network is restricted), and keep the interface consistently Russian with lucide-react icons and CSS anim-* classes.

nodes.label: Subagent-Driven Build Workflow
nodes.rationale: Each build step is a self-contained prompt for a freshly spawned subagent restricted to its own files, which isolates parallel work, keeps the shared contract stable, and lets the orchestrator verify builds between steps.
